claims: As of April 2, 2026, President Trump has appointed Todd Blanche as the acting attorney general.
Todd Blanche is replacing Pam Bondi.
Pam Bondi was removed after serving from February 2025.
Todd Blanche previously served as Deputy Attorney General since March 2025.
Todd Blanche formerly worked as a defense attorney for Trump.
Todd Blanche was confirmed as Deputy Attorney General in a 52-46 party-line vote in 2025.
Pam Bondi was fired after a 14-month tenure
